All credits, referral, promote, promo caption, security headers, rate limit (429 w/ Retry-After), magic-byte photo validation, and UI flows (credits screen, promo sheet pin→credits route, non-host share-party toast, /r/<code> deeplink) are verified end-to-end.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py checkout (1087-1108) correctly 400s when both plan and pack are absent, and 400s on non-http(s) origin (javascript: scheme). grant_if_paid (1111-1123) is idempotent (processed flag) and adds pack credits only once per session_id — verified.
server.py spend_credits (244-249) does an atomic $inc with {credits:{$gte:amount}} filter — correct race-free spend; raises 402 with 'Needs X credits' message matching the PRD.

server.py do_join (838-845) applies the 3/day free limit only when not invited and spends 2 credits when use_credits=true, otherwise 402 with 'credits' in the message — verified in TestJoinWithCredits.

server.py party_view (795) sorts promoted parties first (promoted bool key, then super host), confirmed in TestPromote::test_fresh_host_promote_success_and_sort where the newly promoted party is index 0 of the city feed.

server.py security_middleware (1254-1275) implements a per-IP sliding window on /api/auth/, /api/me/photo, /api/payments/, /api/reports, /api/me/verify-age with 429 + Retry-After, and sets X-Frame-Options=DENY, X-Content-Type-Options=nosniff, Referrer-Policy=no-referrer, Strict-Transport-Security=max-age=31536000 on every response — all verified.
server.py photo upload (562-563) requires magic bytes PNG/JPEG/WEBP/HEIC — b'hello' with image/png content-type correctly 400s with 'valid image'.

credits.tsx (54-63) uses window.location.origin on web for origin_url and window.location.assign to redirect to Stripe URL on web — confirmed as a top-level navigation to checkout.stripe.com in tests.
marketing.tsx PromoSheet (32-44) catches ApiError 402 from /promote and routes the user to /credits with the server message — confirmed.

success_rate.backend: 100% on iter-6 new features (15/15); 100% on test_new_features (8/8) and test_live_features (18/18); 89% on backend_test.py (24/27, 3 environmental fails due to demo-party capacity)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Several London demo parties (party_e19aaf55c089, party_e9a49386c2c0, party_ef043a43df8e, party_663df90492b9) are now at full capacity, which causes backend_test.py's 3-join-limit test (test_free_join_limit_402) and the X-Store-Tier premium-elevation test (test_store_tier_header_elevates) to fail with 400 'Party is full' on the first joins. The iter-6 test_credits_marketing.py suite handles this by looping joins and only skipping when fewer than 3 can succeed. If regression on backend_test.py is required, reset demo attendees or seed more London parties. Rate limiter is per-IP across all /api/auth/*, so run tests one suite at a time with a 60-90s cooldown; the credits suite completes in ~70s single-worker (xdist parallel can trigger 429 cascades across fixtures that log in demo users).
